name: shopify-store-radar
title: Shopify Store Radar — Products, Prices & Stock Changes
description: Track any Shopify store: full product catalog with price, compare-at price, discount %, variant-level stock, and the changes since last run (new products, delisted, price up/down, sold out, back in stock). Reads Shopify's official UCP agent endpoint instead of scraping, so it does not get rate limited, and it sees real stock levels that /products.json hides. For competitor monitoring, assortment research, restock alerts and discount hunting.
